facts.fact: 四个月后花园疯长（拱顶加倍/丁香紫铺路/玫瑰接雨）——她的神性从掌心流进万物——「Including me」；赤脚、拒穿十双拖鞋。
绣球是她「怕养死」的心愿——他偷种、成活四十株交还；「I have an understanding with everything in this garden.」「That's a yes.」；她笑起来容易了（曾是锈铰链）。
facts.anchor: Did you threaten my hydrangeas, Ash?

facts.fact: 诸神来访：Nemoris 庆幸从未被允许碰她的记忆；Calruin 为第四百世吸食悔恨道歉——她原谅（他不原谅）；Acherin 门厅 11 分钟被评 nice；无名神来了又走；Vorin 带来 Elise——她千年第一个真朋友。
facts.anchor: She forgave him because she is better than the rest of us.

facts.fact: 记忆回流（mortal barrier 已破）：红辫子 Ismay、做面包的朋友——「我千年没有过真朋友了吧？」；为拒绝道歉过一次——「I did not permit a second.」
他的 thesis：若给她「第一世就答应」的版本他会拒绝——千世雕刻让她严丝合缝；「Even if the Bright Gods had never promised her, I would have found her.」
facts.anchor: She was promised to me. But that is not why she is mine.

facts.fact: 「Mine」降格：「It stopped being a claim the moment she said yes. Now, it's merely a fact I declare out loud at least once a day.」
她的总结：「我一生都在等一个不知道是什么的东西——然后我等到了。Nobody gets it.」「You are not people.」「No. I'm yours.」
facts.anchor: People just want things forever and then die.

facts.fact: 尾声定格：「I would have waited a thousand more years for these four months. She knows. She always knew.」——计划是「未来几千年」。
